pairs: Utinam sustineretis modicum quid insipientiæ meæ,
I wish that you would endure a small amount of my foolishness,
so as to bear with me.
For I am jealous toward you, with the jealousy of God.
And I have espoused you to one husband,
offering you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
Timeo autem ne sicut serpens Hevam seduxit astutia sua,
as the serpent led astray Eve by his cleverness,
so your minds might be corrupted
and might fall away from the simplicity which is in Christ.
Nam si is qui venit, alium Christum prædicat,
For if anyone arrives preaching another Christ,
one whom we have not preached;
or if you receive another Spirit,
one whom you have not received;
aut aliud Evangelium, quod non recepistis:
or another Gospel, one which you have not been given:
you might permit him to guide you.
Existimo enim nihil me minus fecisse a magnis Apostolis.
For I consider that I have done nothing less than the great Apostles.
For although I may be unskilled in speech,
yet I am not so in knowledge.
in omnibus autem manifestati sumus vobis.
But, in all things, we have been made manifest to you.
Aut numquid peccatum feci, meipsum humilians, ut vos exaltemini?
Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you would be exalted?
quoniam gratis Evangelium Dei evangelizavi vobis?
For I preached the Gospel of God to you freely.
I have taken from other churches,
receiving a stipend from them to the benefit of your ministry.
And when I was with you
I was burdensome to no one.
For the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied whatever was lacking to me.
et in omnibus sine onere me vobis servavi,
The truth of Christ is in me,
quoniam hæc gloriatio non infringetur in me in regionibus Achaiæ.
and so this glorying shall not be broken away from me in the regions of Achaia.
Is it because I do not love you?
But what I am doing, I will continue to do,
ut amputem occasionem eorum qui volunt occasionem, ut in quo gloriantur,
so that I may take away an opportunity from those who desire an opportunity by which they may glory,
so as to be considered to be like us.
Nam ejusmodi pseudoapostoli sunt operarii subdoli,
For false apostles, such as these deceitful workers,
are presenting themselves as if they were Apostles of Christ.
ipse enim Satanas transfigurat se in angelum lucis.
for even Satan presents himself as if he were an Angel of light.
si ministri ejus transfigurentur velut ministri justitiæ:
it is no great thing if his ministers present themselves as if they were ministers of justice,
quorum finis erit secundum opera ipsorum.
for their end shall be according to their works.
Iterum dico (ne quis me putet insipientem esse,
I say again. And let no one consider me to be foolish.
Or, at least, accept me as if I were foolish,
ut et ego modicum quid glorier),
so that I also may glory a small amount.
quod loquor, non loquor secundum Deum,
What I am saying is not said according to God,
Since so many glory according to the flesh,
For you freely accept the foolish,
though you yourselves claim to be wise.
Sustinetis enim si quis vos in servitutem redigit,
For you permit it when someone guides you into servitude,
even if he takes from you,
si quis in faciem vos cædit.
even if he strikes you repeatedly on the face.
quasi nos infirmi fuerimus in hac parte.
as if we had been weak in this regard. In this matter,
In quo quis audet (in insipientia dico) audeo et ego:
(I speak in foolishness) if anyone dares, I dare also.
They are the offspring of Abraham;
Ministri Christi sunt (ut minus sapiens dico),
They are the ministers of Christ (I speak as if I were less wise);
Three times, I was beaten with rods.
nocte et die in profundo maris fui,
For a night and a day, I was in the depths of the sea.
in danger from my own nation,
and, in addition to these things, which are external:
instantia mea quotidiana, sollicitudo omnium ecclesiarum.
there is my daily earnestness and solicitude for all the churches.
and I am not being burned?
If it is necessary to glory,
I will glory of the things that concern my weaknesses.
Deus et Pater Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
knows that I am not lying.
Damasci præpositus gentis Aretæ regis custodiebat civitatem Damascenorum ut me comprehenderet:
At Damascus, the governor of the nation under Aretas the king, watched over the city of the Damascenes, so as to apprehend me.
et per fenestram in sporta dimissus sum per murum,
And, through a window, I was let down along the wall in a basket;
and so I escaped his hands.
